role: Extension of EmuquApp holding the launch work: Watch workout-control notification listeners, deferred singleton boot, the root launch task and its 8 s safety timeout, entitlement gating and launch-modal selection, HealthKit authorization with retry, launch housekeeping scheduled through LaunchCoordinator (archive/session migrations, backup reconcile, workout-load backfill, temp-asymmetry rescore with a persisted cursor, iCloud sync), road-context and haptics prewarm.
types: EmuquApp.MorningPushInputs: struct (private, Equatable) — dailyReportEnabled + dailyReportFixedTime snapshot
EmuquApp.RescoreChunk: struct — progress of one temp-asymmetry rescore run
state: mem:EmuquApp.terminalAuthErrorCodes (static let Set of HKError codes: healthDataUnavailable, healthDataRestricted, invalidArgument, authorizationDenied, userCanceled, requiredAuthorizationDenied)
toplevel: Static lets tempAsymmetryLogEvery=5 (778), tempAsymmetryCursorKey (785), terminalAuthErrorCodes (760-767). No other top-level code.

flags.text: Docs say LPM delays are multiplied 4x and periodic refreshes incl. iCloud sync are skipped, and that sync is delayed 8 s (32 s in LPM); the code passes powerMultiplier to scheduleMigrationJobs/scheduleTrainingJobs/scheduleSyncJob/scheduleWorkoutLoadBackfill/scheduleTempAsymmetryRescore but never uses it there, the sync job has skipInLowPower:false and no delay of its own (it waits only on LaunchCoordinator's dashboard-ready/6 s gate), and skipPeriodic is computed only for a log line.

All housekeeping jobs share LaunchCoordinator's 2 concurrency slots; the temp-asymmetry rescore is documented as 2-4 minutes of CPU and the workout-load backfill awaits the 400-day historical series, so when those two take the slots first the launch iCloud sync (which the doc says must run to heal a broken zone) waits behind them for minutes.

units.does: Runs the five app-level Watch workout listeners concurrently in a task group (never returns while the stream loops run).
Loops over .watchRequestedWorkoutStart notifications, parses sport (default 'run'/.run) and targetZone, and calls startWorkoutFromWatch.

branches.effect: handles it; loop ends on task cancellation

branches.cond: userInfo sport missing or not a Sport (??)

units.does: Starts a strap-sourced workout on the shared recorder for a Watch Start: refuses when paywalled, binds the recorder if needed, ignores when already recording/finalizing, sets targetZone and calls recorder.start; a throw is logged only.

branches.effect: warning debugLog; Watch already told success

units.does: Loops over .watchRequestedWorkoutStop; if a recorder exists and is .recording (incl. paused), spawns Task { await recorder.stop() }.
True only when recorder.phase is .recording.
Loops over .watchRequestedWorkoutPause; pauses (isAuto false) when recording.

branches.effect: pause(isAuto:false) (no-op if already paused); else ignore

units.does: Loops over .watchRequestedWorkoutResume; calls resume() when recording (resume itself no-ops unless paused).
Loops over .watchAcknowledgedFinished; calls acknowledgeFinished() on the recorder if any (moves .finished to .idle and stops a lingering Polar stream).
Root task: snapshots (dailyReportEnabled, dailyReportFixedTime), then on every flowRecoverySettingsChanged recomputes and, only when changed, reschedules the morning notification.
Returns MorningPushInputs(enabled: dailyReportEnabled, fixedTime: dailyReportFixedTime).
Calls boot() on watchBridge, collector, syncManager, storeKitManager, voiceChat via timedBoot and logs the total ms.
Runs `work` and logs its duration when over 50 ms.

branches.effect: debugLogs label and ms; else silent

units.does: Debug builds: plants one scored night into the archive when -UITests-SeedArchive is present (UITestArchiveSeed); Release: no-op.
Root launch task: seeds the UI-test archive, schedules an 8 s safety check, then for a new install flips isLoading and presents the disclaimer, else calls loadDataAndContinue().
8 s after launch: if isLoading is still true, logs the state vector, sets isLoading=false, and when no modal is up presents disclaimer (not accepted) or onboarding (not completed).

branches.effect: true (isLoading false) => returns. This is the only outcome: runLaunchTask spawns this Task after its only await (AppLaunchTasks.swift:178-185) and then, with no further suspension, sets isLoading=false on both paths (190, or loadDataAndContinue:603 / dataLoaded already true means 603 already ran) before the 8 s sleep can end; false branch never executes.
pick fallback modal; else keep current

flags.text: The 8 s launch safety net can never fire: runLaunchTask creates the safety Task only after its sole await (seedArchiveForUITests) and then synchronously reaches isLoading=false on both paths on the main actor, so runLaunchSafetyCheck always returns at its first guard and the fallback disclaimer/onboarding presentation (211-216) is dead. The comment at 171-176 and docs/MAINTAINERS.md:540 ("An 8 s safety timeout force-clears the splash if a background init hangs") describe protection that does not exist; isLoading also drives no view (EmuquApp.swift:287-288).

units.does: Starts an unstructured Task(priority: .userInitiated) (inherits the main actor; not detached) that awaits storeKitManager.refreshStatus() and then on the main actor runs presentPaywallIfNowRequired().
Presents the paywall when the paywall is enabled, StoreKitManager.hasActiveAccess is false, onboarding is complete and no other modal is up.

flags.text: Can raise the paywall in the middle of an active overnight recording or workout when called from loadDataAndContinue's refresh (only the foreground recheck guards isRecordingInProgress).

units.does: For onboarded users who did not skip Health access, after 200 ms (if HealthKit is available) runs the authorization request with one retry.
Utility Task: sleeps 4 s x powerMultiplier, then if shouldPrewarmRoadContext() fetches a location and prewarms road geocoding.
Gate for road-context prewarm: false if the AI assistant is off, if location is not authorized (When In Use/Always), or if the cached RoadContext is younger than 900 s; else true.

branches.cond: cached context exists and < 900 s old

units.does: Gets the first usable location (8 s timeout) via LocationFinder and calls RoadGeocodingService.prewarm(at:) on main; failure only NSLogged.
Utility Task: sleeps 2 s x powerMultiplier then prepares the WorkoutStartCue haptic generators.
On main actor calls prepare() on WorkoutStartCue.notificationFeedback and impactFeedback.

Configures the training-metrics cache with HealthKit, reads LPM multiplier/skip flags (logging in LPM), begins LaunchCoordinator, schedules migrations, road/haptic prewarms, training jobs, sync job, and reschedules the morning notification.

branches.effect: prints SKIPPED or kept; value is otherwise unused

units.does: Schedules two housekeeping-phase background jobs (archive file-protection upgrade + deferred migrations + trash expiry; collector session migrations) and the backup reconcile; never skipped in LPM; powerMultiplier unused.
Housekeeping job: reconciles raw backups flagged unarchived against the archive's session ids, logging how many were corrected.
Housekeeping job skipped in LPM: WorkoutLoadBackfill.runIfNeeded, FTPAutoEstimator.recomputeIfNeeded on main, trainingMetricsCache.refresh(), then awaits the 400-day historical series.
Schedules the workout-load backfill and the temp-asymmetry rescore.
Unless hasFixedTempAsymmetry is set, schedules an LPM-skipped housekeeping job that runs the cursor-based rescore and, when complete, sets settings.hasFixedTempAsymmetry = true.

branches.effect: job returns without setting the flag (resumes next launch)

units.does: For onboarded users schedules a housekeeping job (never LPM-skipped) running performFullSyncIfNeeded(minInterval: 30 min); before onboarding, NSLogs and skips.

Once per process: flips isLoading off, prepares the entitlement gate, picks the launch modal (or checks for interrupted session), refreshes entitlements in background, requests HealthKit auth if onboarded, and schedules launch housekeeping.
Promotes the keychain EntitlementAnchor into its fast tier, migrates the legacy TestFlight flag, grandfathers existing users with archive history, and NSLogs access state.

Chooses the launch modal: onboarding if not onboarded; else the paywall/trial reminder from paywallModal(); else the score-architecture disclosure if not acknowledged; then (only when onboarded and not gated) checks for an interrupted session.

branches.effect: activeModal = .scoreArchitectureChange then still checks interrupted session; acknowledged: log only

flags.text: docs/MAINTAINERS.md:543-548 gives the gate as "... in-trial -> TrialReminderView; score-architecture change unacknowledged -> ScoreArchitectureChangeSheet; else check for an interrupted session" in loadDataAndContinue. Code: the disclaimer gate is in runLaunchTask, the trial reminder shows only in the last 7 trial days, without permanent access and once a day (PaywallGatePolicy.swift:31-34), and the interrupted-session check also runs when the score-architecture sheet is presented (664 follows 660), not only in the else case.

units.does: Returns PaywallGatePolicy.launchModal(hasAccess, hasPermanentAccess, isInTrial, trialDaysRemaining, reminderShownToday) when the paywall is enabled or forced by the UI-test argument; nil otherwise; logs the choice.
Access past the paywall: false under -UITests-ForcePaywall; else isPurchased || grandfathered beta tester || developer install || settingsManager.isInTrialPeriod.

branches.effect: returns false; else the OR of routes

units.does: Starts the HealthKit sleep observer, then up to 2 authorization attempts with 1.5 s sleep between, stopping as soon as an attempt reports done.

branches.effect: return; false: sleep 1.5 s and try next

units.does: Requests HealthKit authorization; on success restarts the sleep observer and returns true; on error returns true unless the error is a retryable HK error on attempt 1.
Logs the failure and returns true only for an HKErrorDomain error whose code is not terminal, on attempt < 2.

Loads the processed-UUID cursor, snapshots archive entries on main, rescores every unprocessed session (cursor saved after each), and returns progress with complete = every current entry is in the cursor.
Iterates unprocessed entries: stops on task cancellation, rescores each, inserts it into the cursor, persists the cursor, and NSLogs every 5 sessions; returns count processed.

Retrieves the session detached at background priority; skips if retrieval fails/nil, the window was user-adjusted, or there are no RR points; otherwise reanalyzes it via ReanalysisService (preserveManualWindows) which persists the rescored session; result discarded.

branches.cond: retrieve throws/nil, windowUserAdjusted, or no RR points
branches.effect: returns without rescoring (caller still marks it processed)

flags.text: A retrieve error is swallowed by try? and a nil reanalysis result is ignored, yet rescoreAll inserts the id into the persisted cursor regardless, so a session whose decrypt failed transiently (e.g. a background launch while protected data is unavailable) or whose reanalysis failed is never retried and keeps its pre-fix temp-asymmetry score once hasFixedTempAsymmetry flips.

units.does: Reads the cursor JSON from UserDefaults and returns the set of valid UUIDs; missing/undecodable data yields an empty set.

branches.cond: no data or JSON decode fails

units.does: JSON-encodes the UUID strings and writes them to UserDefaults; an encode failure is swallowed by attempt() and nothing is written.
